buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 3. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 6. Past Project Experience Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc.Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc. 7. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also

(besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of PFA/SER/GRC payable at KOLKATA . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Online tenders are invited from eligible bidders for Hiring of 4 Nos. Vehicles. The contract will be for a peri od of 31 months and fifteen days. Bidders must meet the eligibility criteria mentioned below to participate in this tender. 1. Scope of Work: The scope of work includes providing 4 Nos. vehicles along with qualified drivers as per the terms and cond itions outlined in the tender document. 2. Document to submit in Technical Bid. The bidder must possess a minimum of three (3) years of verifiabl e experience in executing work of a similar nature in one order, showcasing their proficiency and consisten t performance in the relevant domain.The bidder must have successfully executed/completed similar Servi ces over the last three years i.e. the current financial year and the last three financial years(ending month of March prior to the bid opening): - a. Three similar completed services costing not less than the amount equal to 40% (forty percent) of the es timated cost; or b. Two similar completed services costing not less than the amount equal to 50% (fifty percent) of the esti mated cost; or c. One similar completed service costing not less than the amount equal to 80% (eighty percent) of the esti mated cost. The bidder must furnish an affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper, duly notarized, declaring that neither the bidder nor any of its proprietors, partners, or directors have been blacklisted, debarred, or declared ineligi ble by any government, semi-government, or private organization for corrupt, fraudulent, or non-complian t practices. The bidder shall assume full responsibility for any discrepancies or fraudulent claims. The bidd er must have valid EPF (Employees' Provident Fund) and ESIC (Employees' State Insurance Corporation) re gistrations. The bidder must have a local office situated in Jharkhand, to ensure effective communication, c oordination, and swift execution of the project. All documents submitted as part of the tender must be self- attested with date by the bidder. 3. Cost of FASTags/Night charges/Octroi/Toll Tax/ Parking Charges/Driver allowances or any other charges shall be beared by the service provider. No extra charges will be payable other than finalised contract rate . Mandatory FASTags experience shall be beared by the service provider, Railway will not bear any such ty pe of cost. 4) Firm must submit vehicle details for the tendered vehicle within 03 days after issuance of Purchase Ord er. 5) Monthly salary payment to all the drivers must be paid through online. Necessary documents for payme nt/receipt like RTGS/UPI/Pass book etc. to be submitted along with logbook. Any delay beyond monthly cyc le for drivers salary payment, per day penalty of Rs. 1000/- will be recovered till the date of salary paymen t. This will be applicable to all the driver. 6) Minimum wages must be paid to all the driver else penalty of ₹25000/-per month per driver will be reco vered. 7) The driver should have the valid driving license and Commercially Registered vehicle should be insured against Accident etc. as per rules and statutory obligations. 8) The bidder must arrange provident fund & ESIC registration for all the drivers. The deduction of provide nt fund & ESIC need to be provide during the passing of bill.

9)Availability of mobile phones in working conditions with the vehicle drivers is compulsory. Mobile should be complete with live SIM Card & Driver must response the phone as and when called by the controlling off icer even at night in case of urgency. The cost of the same will be borne by the contractor and for which n o extra payment is payable by the Railway. 10) Vehicle supplied by agency without fuel will be treated as absent for the day. ₹5000/- per day penalty will impose in no fuel situation. Driver should keep record for fueling being done. It much be ensured that vehicle should reach to officer/staff only with full fueling condition, driver should not carry the officer/staff on any fueling station for fueling of vehicle. A penalty of ₹5000/- per occasion will be recovered if driver wil l carry the vehicle with officer/staff to any fuel station for fueling purpose during duty hour. 11. General Terms and Conditions: The vehicles should be in excellent working condition, with valid permit s and insurance. The drivers should be experienced, possess valid driving licenses, and be registered unde r EPF and ESIC. The successful bidder will be responsible for the maintenance, fuel, and other operational. 12. Contract to be registered in "Shramik Kalyan Portal" after issue of work order and updated the position every month. 13. The rates are inclusive of Hiring vehicles, drivers, fuel with all other taxes. .
